newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government will launch its social protection programme at the end of this week, National Peasant Party (PNT-CD) leaders said.
* The measure to double petrol prices was triggered by the former government's policy to postpone reforms in the past four years, PNT-CD secretary general Radu Vasile told a news conference.
He said the government will start negotiations with labour unions over planned compensations measures.
* The ruling coalition parties are expected to meet in the afternoon for further talks on appointing state secretaries.
* Industrial output rose by 9.1 percent in January-November 1996 compared with the same period of 1995.
* Exports fell by 5.8 percent in January-November 1996 from the eleven-month period of the previous year.
* Net average wage in November was 380,375 lei. ($= 4,136 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
